claims: Take, read and release claims on work, paths and seats.
claims coordination: Take and release claims on shared operations.
claims coordination claim: Take and release claims on shared operations.
claims coordination claim acquire: Claim a shared operation for this session.
claims coordination-claim: Take and release claims on shared operations.
claims coordination-claim acquire: Claim a shared operation for this session.
claims coordination-claim operator-relea: Free a shared-operation claim held by another session.
claims path: Reserve the repository paths an item will change.
claims path activation-run: Activate an item's planned path claims from this checkout.
claims path amend: Add or remove paths on an existing path claim.
claims path boundary-prove: Record proof of an item's local lane for hosted checks.
claims path cancel: Cancel path coverage for abandoned work.
claims path coordination-decision-build: Prepare a decision on paths another claim already holds.
claims path list: List an item's path claims, optionally by state.
claims path override: Let a path claim proceed past a conflict, with a reason.
claims path register: Claim the repository paths an item will change.
claims path release: Release path coverage once the work is finished.
claims path required-gate: Check whether an item has every path claim it needs.
claims path widen: Add paths to an existing path claim.
claims steering: Take, check and release steering seats over a project.
claims steering acquire: Take a steering seat over a project or strategy document.
claims steering list: List steering seats, optionally only active ones.
claims steering verify: Check whether this session holds a project steering seat.
claims work: Take, read and release claims on work items.
claims work acquire: Claim an item, epic task or process for this session.
claims work claim: Take, read and release claims on work items.
claims work claim acquire: Claim an item, epic task or process for this session.
claims work claim get: Show who holds the work claim on an item or path.
claims work claim list: List work claims for an item or a session.
claims work claim release: Release a work claim this session holds.
claims work current: Show who holds the work claim on an item.
claims work holder-get: Show who holds the work claim on an item or path.
claims work holder-list: List work claims for an item or a session.
claims work list: List work claims for an item or a session.
claims work release: Release a work claim this session holds.
claims work status: Show who holds the work claim on an item.
claims work-claim: Take, read and release claims on work items.
claims work-claim acquire: Claim an item, epic task or process for this session.
claims work-claim get: Show who holds the work claim on an item or path.
claims work-claim list: List work claims for an item or a session.
claims work-claim release: Release a work claim this session holds.
